title.narrative: Empowerment of Civil Society Organisations to Contribute to Gender Equality in Migrant and hosting Communities in Greater Cairo

description.narrative: The proposed Action will contribute to the call¿s global objective ¿to strengthen the role of Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) as governance and development actors in Egypt,¿ and more particularly to the call¿s Lot two entitled ¿capacity building of CSOs to develop innovative solutions to respond to crosscutting challenges in Egypt in relation to at least two of the following thematic areas: environment, culture, digitalization, migration and gender equality.¿ Among the five thematic areas, the proposed action will primarily address migration and gender equality. Building on local and global experiences of Handicap International (HI), the proposed action will empower local CSOs to become active contributor to the empowerment and socio-economic inclusion of migrant and Egyptian women in migrant host communities in Greater Cairo.
